simple.meaning: אֶתְנִי (ʼEthnîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “Ethni , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.summary: אֶתְנִי (ʼEthnîy) / H867 is traced through 1 Chronicles 6:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H867. Ethni אֶתְנִי proper name, masculine an ancestor of Asaph 1Chr 6:26 apparently identical with יְאָֽתְרַי v. 6:6 . אֶתְנַן see II. תנן .
